definitions.selection: All recent same-model provided-MSA standard-protocol native hits strictly below 2 A, plus the previously established FKBP12/FK5 Boltz-2 browser-miss diagnostic. Selection frozen before new stock inference.
definitions.alignment: All observed corresponding protein C-alpha atoms; no trimming, pocket or ligand refit.
definitions.oracle: Best observed RMSD uses the crystal answer; it is not prospective pose selection.
definitions.confidenceSelection: Largest reported ipTM, lowest model seed to break ties; independent of the crystal answer.
definitions.failures: Every planned prediction remains in the denominator; execution failures are separated from geometric misses.
definitions.scope: Original quantized LocalFold page at explicit sampling settings; not a matched-tensor implementation-parity test.
